observed_behavior: Promotion Candidate loading accepts an ordinary leaf reached through a Windows junction ancestor that the shared component checker classifies as redirected.
expected_behavior: Sealing, loading and applying validate every existing component from the canonical registry root and use stable regular-file read or create boundaries.
impact: Promotion can accept or create Candidate bytes outside the canonical registry tree, breaking sealed identity and application integrity.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: A junction ancestor is rejected before Candidate bytes are read while an ordinary registry path remains accepted.
steps: Create an isolated Windows registry and an external Candidate tree.
Make repos/<repo-id> a junction to that external tree while leaving candidate.json ordinary.
Compare _candidate_path acceptance with the existing component-walk result.
reproduction.sample: The ancestor was a junction, the leaf was ordinary, the component checker returned true, and _candidate_path still accepted the Candidate path.

root_cause.summary: Promotion Candidate load and persistence resolve or inspect the leaf without a stable component walk from the canonical registry root across every existing ancestor.

next_action: Implementation executor adds Windows junction, ordinary-path and read or create drift reds, introduces shared component-safe registry primitives, and reruns Windows/Linux full verification.
